steps.name: Discover
steps.detail: A fact, story or object that opens a door — no lecture, just a spark.

steps.name: Question
steps.detail: Children ask what, why and what if, before anyone gives them an answer.

steps.name: Think
steps.detail: Space to reason it out loud, alone or with the group.

steps.name: Solve
steps.detail: A puzzle or activity that turns the idea into a small, real challenge.

steps.name: Discuss
steps.detail: Sharing thinking with others — where understanding actually sharpens.

steps.name: Apply
steps.detail: Carrying the idea into a real decision, at home or in the world.
